parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The primary domain name.
<props="china">For more information, see [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29751.html).</props>
<props="intl">For more information, see [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains).</props>

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

- PUBLIC (default): authoritative domain name

- CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
The end date of the query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

The default value is the current date.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh (default): Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: Rr
parameters.description: The host record. For example, to resolve www\.example.com, set this parameter to www.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
The start date of the query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

The start date must be within the last 90 days.

If the time range of the query is 7 days or less, data is returned by the hour.

If the time range of the query is more than 7 days, data is returned by the day.
